properties.description:
Where a schema property carries no information when unstated, the design does not store a value for it — so an ABSENT property honestly means "nobody said" and a PRESENT one means somebody chose.

THE ROUTE CHANGED ON A MEASUREMENT, and the old description had it backwards. This capability used to say the EXPORT omits a value equal to the default. That cannot work: `default:` in the schema YAML is not documentation, it is an instruction dynograph-core executes at WRITE time (`dynograph-core/src/schema.rs:507` inserts any missing property that declares one, before validation). So the store holds an injected `atomic` and a chosen `atomic` identically, and stripping value==default at export would destroy the choice along with the injection — absence would come to mean "nobody said OR somebody said the default", which looks like the distinction without being it.

⇒ THE FIX IS ONE YAML TOKEN PER PROPERTY: remove `default:` where injection is wrong. No code, no repo boundary crossed (dynograph is not modified), and FORWARD-ONLY — nodes already written keep what they hold, so the committed export does not churn and `compare_designs` sees nothing. The phantom-diff cost `fact:bl-198` warned about, and that step 2 of `dec:fix-the-comparison-before-pointing-it-earlier` exists to disclose, DOES NOT ARISE on this route.

TEN OF 81 REMOVED, 71 KEPT (2026-08-10, Anthony confirming each list). Removed: Requirement.kind/concern/designation, Capability.tier, Component.kind, Fragment.fragment_type — descriptive enums nobody chooses — plus Capability.is_entry_point/is_exit_point and Component.tier, which have ZERO string-literal occurrences anywhere in either crate and are dead vocabulary materialised on every node, and Release.unit_type, which asserted every release is a container while reflow2 ships tarballs.

⭐ THE RATIO IS THE FINDING, not the removals. Three mechanically-obvious candidates were KEPT on evidence, each for a reason already on the record: `Requirement.lineage` is the base case of a three-way classification whose other values are set by operations (`requirement_lineage.rs` caught it); `Interface.auth`/`transport_security`/`medium = unspecified` were deliberately added and defaulted in 2026-07-28 after BL-129, where a defaulted REST made two boundaries falsely agree, and `seam.rs` already normalises `unspecified` to absent; `TemporalFact.basis = measured` is the base case of a binary whose other value `forecast` is set explicitly by readiness. The reflex that single-valued means informationless was wrong three times in ten.

📌 AND A METHOD CORRECTION worth carrying: "is this property read?" cannot be answered by grepping `get("prop")`. `seam.rs` reads interface properties by DYNAMIC STRING KEY (`BASE_AXES`), so `auth` and `transport_security` measured as unread and were not. The reliable test is any string-literal occurrence of the property name.

WHAT REMAINS: the 3,207 values already stored stay, and always were indistinguishable — nothing can retroactively recover a choice nobody recorded. From here, absence is honest for anything newly written.
properties.name: A property nobody chose is not stored, so absence means nobody said
